snippet.title: Carnival Roulette - Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Carnival Roulette, a tense card-roulette game where every decision could be your last.
Choose your card. Choose your target.
Live bullet or blank — fate decides.

The first playable demo is now available on itch.io.
This demo is a proof of concept focused on atmosphere, core mechanics, and tension. Your feedback will help shape the future of the game.

Demo Link 
https://hmogames.itch.io/carnival-roulette

🎮 Features in the demo:
• Card-based roulette gameplay
• A Dealer who interferes and changes the rules
• Brutal, short rounds full of suspense
• A dark carnival atmosphere

👉 Wishlist on Steam to support the project
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4260520?utm_source=youtube
👉 Join the Discord to share feedback and follow development
https://discord.gg/wkRTeDzTT9

Made by a solo developer 
See you at the table.
